title: Desktop app: the window wired to enrollment, the saved device and the connection worker
spec: A Controller that starts from the device store (saved device: start the worker and show sign-in; none: ask for enrollment; no data folder or an unreadable record: say why), turns window Actions into Enrollment, Worker and store calls, and turns enrollment and worker events into window Updates (a lost connection signs out and asks for a new code). An invitation link is resolved by a Join supplied by main. The eframe DesktopApp polls the controller, draws the window and forwards its actions each frame; main opens it when run with no arguments.
